gitCommit.subject: authz: migrate all routes to the capability chokepoint (pv9 PR4) (#238)
gitCommit.body:
authz: migrate all routes to the capability chokepoint (pv9 PR4) (#238)

* fix(authz): migrate collections/[id] CRUD+archive+restore to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o)

PATCH/DELETE /collections/[id], archive, restore: replaced canManageCollection +
isOwner checks with requireApiCapability(..., "collection:manage"). Pin-flipped
lifecycle-routes absent-collection POST/members test: 403→404 (resolve-then-authorize).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): migrate collections/[id]/items routes to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o)

GET items:read, POST items:write; item PATCH items:write (dropped canEditMetadata
flag — full-curator model). Pin-flipped core-routes tests: curator member now 200s
on PATCH (not 403), items POST seeds owner (not any-authed-user).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): migrate item photo routes to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o)

photos POST/rotate/DELETE/set-hero/file/reassign: dropped canAddPhotos,
canDeletePhotos flag checks → photos:write or items:read. Pin-flipped
item-photo-routes tests: curator member now 200s/201s regardless of
canAddPhotos/canDeletePhotos (full-curator model, flags inert).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): migrate pool routes to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o)

pool/upload: assertCanAddPhotos now calls requireApiCapability(photos:write)
instead of MembershipRepository+CollectionRepository inline check. pool/group,
pool/photos, pool/photos/[photoId]/file: same migration. Unit test rewritten
to mock requireApiCapability at the DAL seam (not repo mocks).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): migrate members routes to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o, purses-lgql)

GET members:read (curator), POST/PATCH/DELETE members:manage (owner-only by role).
Dropped isCollectionManager / canManageCollection flag checks. Pin-flipped
members-routes: absent-collection POST now 404 (was 403); canManageCollection
flag test updated to reflect flag-is-inert framing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): migrate invitation routes to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o, 4wj2-A)

collections/[id]/invitations GET→invitations:read, POST→invitations:manage
(owner-only — closes 4wj2-A curator tightening). invitations/[id] and
invitations/[id]/resend: requireApiInvitationCapability. Pin-flipped
collection-invitations-routes tests: curator 201→403 on create, 200→403 on list.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): migrate top-level /api/items routes to requireApiItemCapability (purses-g6o)

items POST→requireApiCapability(items:write), GET/PATCH/DELETE/restore→
requireApiItemCapability (items:read/write), purge+remove-from-sorts→
requireApiItemCapability(items:purge, includeDeleted:true). Removed inline
ItemRepository + requireApiCollectionOwner patterns.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): add requireCollectionOwnerPage; gate edit + members pages (purses-yqw)

src/lib/collection-access.ts: new requireCollectionOwnerPage — resolves via
requireCollectionAccess then redirects curators to the collection detail page.
edit/page.tsx: owner-only (was curator-access + isOwner conditional rendering).
members/page.tsx: owner-only (was canManageCollection flag — flag is inert post-pv9).
edit/page.test.tsx: updated mock to requireCollectionOwnerPage; second test is now
redirect-on-non-owner, not conditional-render.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* test(authz): restore non-member 403 on loosened photo routes + real requireCollectionOwnerPage test; remove dead authz helpers + name/comment rot (purses-g6o)

FIX 1: add NON-MEMBER stranger 403 tests to upload(POST)/rotate(PATCH)/delete(DELETE)
in item-photo-routes — each asserts 403 + state unchanged (no put/no row; rotation
unchanged; row survives). The curator-loosening flips had left these blocks with zero
403 assertions.

FIX 2: new collection-access-page.integration.test.ts — real un-mocked DB test of
requireCollectionOwnerPage (owner returns collection / curator redirects to detail page
by slug / absent + non-member redirect to /collections). The edit-page unit test only
mocked the guard.

FIX 3: remove dead authz helpers with zero call sites — CollectionController
.canManageCollection + .isOwner, MemberController.isCollectionManager (and its injected
collectionRepo dependency + ICollectionRepository import). Updated the 5 MemberController
call sites and dropped now-unused CollectionRepository imports in both members routes.

FIX 4: rename assertCanAddPhotos -> assertPhotosWrite (pool/upload); refresh stale test
header comments in pool-routes, collection-items-routes, item-photo-routes, and
lifecycle-routes to describe current capability-gated behavior (gaps closed in PR4); note
intentional UI-stricter-than-API display drift in the items page test; drop an unused
membershipRepo in pool-routes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(api): route→capability migration (pv9 PR4) — owner/curator per-route Access + model

Refs: purses-g6o, purses-lgql, purses-4wj2

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* chore(graphify): refresh after pv9 PR4 (route migration)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

authz: migrate all routes to the capability chokepoint (pv9 PR4) (#238)

* fix(authz): migrate collections/[id] CRUD+archive+restore to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o)

PATCH/DELETE /collections/[id], archive, restore: replaced canManageCollection +
isOwner checks with requireApiCapability(..., "collection:manage"). Pin-flipped
lifecycle-routes absent-collection POST/members test: 403→404 (resolve-then-authorize).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): migrate collections/[id]/items routes to requireApiCapability (purses-g6o)

GET items:read, POST items:write; item PATCH items:write (dropped canEditMetadata
flag — full-curator model). Pin-flipped core-routes tests: curator member now 200s
on PATCH (not 403), items POST seeds owner (not any-authed-user).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

photos POST/rotate/DELETE/set-hero/file/reassign: dropped canAddPhotos,
canDeletePhotos flag checks → photos:write or items:read. Pin-flipped
item-photo-routes tests: curator member now 200s/201s regardless of
canAddPhotos/canDeletePhotos (full-curator model, flags inert).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

pool/upload: assertCanAddPhotos now calls requireApiCapability(photos:write)
instead of MembershipRepository+CollectionRepository inline check. pool/group,
pool/photos, pool/photos/[photoId]/file: same migration. Unit test rewritten
to mock requireApiCapability at the DAL seam (not repo mocks).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

GET members:read (curator), POST/PATCH/DELETE members:manage (owner-only by role).
Dropped isCollectionManager / canManageCollection flag checks. Pin-flipped
members-routes: absent-collection POST now 404 (was 403); canManageCollection
flag test updated to reflect flag-is-inert framing.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

collections/[id]/invitations GET→invitations:read, POST→invitations:manage
(owner-only — closes 4wj2-A curator tightening). invitations/[id] and
invitations/[id]/resend: requireApiInvitationCapability. Pin-flipped
collection-invitations-routes tests: curator 201→403 on create, 200→403 on list.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

items POST→requireApiCapability(items:write), GET/PATCH/DELETE/restore→

requireApiItemCapability(items:purge, includeDeleted:true). Removed inline
ItemRepository + requireApiCollectionOwner patterns.

src/lib/collection-access.ts: new requireCollectionOwnerPage — resolves via
requireCollectionAccess then redirects curators to the collection detail page.
edit/page.tsx: owner-only (was curator-access + isOwner conditional rendering).
members/page.tsx: owner-only (was canManageCollection flag — flag is inert post-pv9).
edit/page.test.tsx: updated mock to requireCollectionOwnerPage; second test is now
redirect-on-non-owner, not conditional-render.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

FIX 1: add NON-MEMBER stranger 403 tests to upload(POST)/rotate(PATCH)/delete(DELETE)
in item-photo-routes — each asserts 403 + state unchanged (no put/no row; rotation
unchanged; row survives). The curator-loosening flips had left these blocks with zero

.canManageCollection + .isOwner, MemberController.isCollectionManager (and its injected
collectionRepo dependency + ICollectionRepository import). Updated the 5 MemberController
call sites and dropped now-unused CollectionRepository imports in both members routes.

FIX 4: rename assertCanAddPhotos -> assertPhotosWrite (pool/upload); refresh stale test
header comments in pool-routes, collection-items-routes, item-photo-routes, and
lifecycle-routes to describe current capability-gated behavior (gaps closed in PR4); note
intentional UI-stricter-than-API display drift in the items page test; drop an unused
membershipRepo in pool-routes.
